cards.note: The card counts the DASHBOARD window, not the orders list. It is not a count of "all orders" either — it is a count of the last 30 days.

actuallyEnforcedByTheEndpoint.note: The endpoint the dashboard calls only refuses a change when the CURRENT status is DELIVERED or CANCELLED. Every other pair is accepted, so PENDING -> DELIVERED is allowed.

The dashboard endpoint (PUT /api/dashboard/orders/{id}/status -> OrderService.updateStatus) refuses only DELIVERED and CANCELLED as the CURRENT status, so PENDING -> DELIVERED is accepted. The UI must therefore enforce the strict map itself, and the backend should be fixed to use the strict map.

missingBackendCapabilities.orderStatusHistory: No order_status_history table, entity, repository or endpoint.

missingBackendCapabilities.shipment: No shipment entity: no carrier, tracking number, tracking URL, shipped_at or delivered_at.

missingBackendCapabilities.resendOrderEmail: Order e-mail is sent on order placed and on order shipped, but there is no endpoint to re-send it on demand.
missingBackendCapabilities.transactionReference: No payment transaction reference, paid_at or per-order refund list is exposed on OrderResponse.
